title: attribute-driven-service-binding-and-kms-residency-guard
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: customers need tighter, attribute-aware RBAC for service-to-service key usage combined with enforceable KMS residency constraints to satisfy data locality controls. This PR introduces an attribute-driven service binding layer that maps workload attributes (tenant_id, geo_zone, compliance_profile) to service roles and permitted KMS provider sets, and a lightweight KMS Residency Guard that enforces region pinning at allocation time and backs off to a controlled fallback with explicit audit events when strict residency cannot be honored. Changes are implemented in a backward-compatible rollout: new policy entries are ignored unless a feature flag is enabled per-tenant; default behaviour remains unchanged. Migration: a small migration script converts legacy tenant_kms_allowlists into the new attribute binding format and emits audit records to the admin topic for manual verification. Rollout plan: enable in staging for 1 week, run e2e compliance tests, opt a handful of pilot tenants, then flip feature flag cluster-wide. Tests: unit, integration, and e2e (mock KMS) added; performance impact measured and summarized in docs. Related work: Linear ENG-5367 (RBAC v2 rollout), SEC-1023 (KMS policy audit harmonization).
commits: feat(rbac): introduce AttributeServiceBinding and policy evaluator (pri-1)
feat(kms): add ResidencyGuard with provider scoring and audit hooks
test: add integration tests for residency guard and fallback path
docs: add operational runbook and examples for attribute bindings
review_comments: Evan Brooks (review): Can we get stronger audit context on fallback events? Suggested including original allocation request and resolved provider set. Response: added AuditAllocation proto fields and included the request snapshot in the audit envelope (see pkg/kms/residency_guard.go).

Lucia Gomez (review): Concern about policy evaluator performance on hot paths. Response: implemented a small LRU cache keyed by (tenant,geo,profile) with time-based invalidation and documented cache sizing; microbenchmarks attached to PR. Lucia approved after cache added.

Samir Khan (security): Asked for explicit deny precedence tests and a test for malformed attribute values. Response: added unit tests and a validation step that rejects attribute bindings with wildcard geo values when tenant policy disallows them.
CI flake: initial lint failed due to gofmt in attribute_binding.go; author pushed fix and re-ran pipeline.
Ops note (post-merge): add an alert for sustained fallback rates >0.1% over 5m to avoid silent cross-region key use.
release_notes: Adds attribute-driven service bindings and a KMS Residency Guard. New feature is opt-in via tenant feature flag; includes migration tool to convert legacy allowlists. Adds audit enrichment for residency fallback events and an operational runbook.
